checkpoints.outcome: Cycle 7 execution is complete: the owner-authorized touch-target acceptance rule is recorded as one canonical structured record, TTR-001 v1.0.0, carrying a 44 by 44 CSS pixel SHOULD default, a distinct 24 by 24 CSS pixel MUST floor, five documented exceptions, a compact-target departure band of 24 to 43 CSS pixels that cannot reach below the floor, and a deterministic verification protocol at 320, 768, and 1366 CSS pixels whose execution state is NOT-RUN.
checkpoints.closed_nothing: Cycle 7 closed nothing beyond the FND-023 definition gap. It ran no interface audit, measured and classified no target, changed no interface, adopted, assessed, or implemented no candidate, left HREQ-025 unchanged at NEEDS-EVIDENCE / DEFER, left EV-003 NOT-RUN, closed neither WP-007 nor Gate A, and authorized no successor cycle.

checkpoints.title: Product Alpha 001 — first synthetic evidence-to-action learning loop implemented
checkpoints.outcome: Product Alpha 001 is implemented under DEC-023 as one bounded, local-only synthetic vertical slice. Five canonical product record types carry strict schemas and enforced cross-record invariants; observations and results are append-only with explicit supersession; a repository boundary with browser-local and in-memory adapters validates every write; export is byte-stable and import is a previewed replace; and LLR-001 v1.0.0 computes a deterministic next step that always cites the records it read. The /learners and /learners/$learnerId routes present the loop as a working founder-operator workflow.
checkpoints.closed_nothing: This checkpoint closed nothing beyond the implementation itself. It ran no interface audit, measured and classified no target against TTR-001, left FND-024 open and EV-003 NOT-RUN, left HREQ-025 at NEEDS-EVIDENCE / DEFER, closed neither WP-007 nor Gate A, authorized no successor cycle, and introduced no backend, authentication, tenancy, artificial-intelligence, or real personal data.

attempts.title: WP-007 Cycle 8 — TTR-001 touch-target audit execution attempt
attempts.statement: An attempt to execute the TTR-001 verification protocol added audit-only tooling under scripts/accessibility/ and a playwright-core development dependency. The browser run exceeded the execution ceiling before any page was measured and was stopped. Further execution is deferred by DEC-022.
attempts.produced_no_evidence: No audit artifact exists. No route, component, or control was measured or classified. At the time of ATTEMPT-001 there was no touch-target audit checkpoint and no touch-target audit evidence: no data/accessibility/touch-target-audit.json, no TTA-001, and no EV-044 audit result. The later CHECKPOINT-010 is the unrelated Product Alpha 001 implementation checkpoint and is not touch-target audit evidence. This attempt is dormant development tooling, not an executed audit, a validation, an evidence record, an accessibility result, or a conformance basis.
